title: Exhausted-AI Human Escalation Gate v1
summary: K0のhuman-attention triageの後段で、DA・Counter-DA・追加検証から得た新しい知識を次の判断へ逐次統合し、判別可能なUNKNOWNをAI側で潰し続ける。妥当な決断、追加Evidence取得、判別可能な次実験、安全な保留条件のいずれも新たに作れない知識固定点に達し、かつ残る未決定が結果へ実質的影響を持つ場合だけHUMAN_NOWへの差し戻しを許可する。
original_problem: K0は76件を35 HUMAN_NOW / 11 HUMAN_LATER / 30 DEFERまで絞ったが、再検証すると35件の多くは重要かつactionableというだけで、reasoning/config/migration等に追加Probeや再検証経路が残っていた。さらに最初は13件が次手不明に見えたが、反証で得た知識を再投入すると全件にAI側の追加検証経路が見つかった。重要であること、難しいこと、現時点で分からないことと、人間が決める必要があることを分離する必要がある。
why_it_matters: 人間の注意はAI側の探索・反証・検証・学習統合を使い切った残余判断にだけ投入すべきである。検証で得た知識を次の探索へ戻さず途中状態を人間へ返すと、AIによる問題解決能力を使い切れずレビュー待ちを増やす。K1は『AIが分からない』ではなく『AIが得た知識を統合しても、もう判別可能な次手を生成できない』を人間差し戻し条件にする。
reason_frozen: high impact、perspective disagreement、低confidence、一定回数の試行だけでHUMAN_NOWにする、未実施検証をEXHAUSTED扱いする、反証で得た新知識を次の判断へ統合せず同じUNKNOWNを残す、安全なdefer条件や判別Probeがあるのに人へ返す、逆に全経路が尽きmaterially重要な案件をsilent deferする、という失敗をDAで禁止するまで実装しない。
preserved_value: K0 triage record and exact source anchor are preserved
every completed DA, Counter-DA and verification result feeds a cumulative knowledge state
failed or refuting probes are learning evidence and must reduce or reshape the remaining UNKNOWN before another escalation decision
attempt count is not exhaustion; exhaustion means no defensible decision, evidence-acquisition path, discriminating probe or safe defer can be generated from the accumulated knowledge
available discriminating probe keeps work on the AI side
safe defer condition prevents premature human escalation
HUMAN_NOW requires explicit bounded exhaustion evidence and a no-new-discriminating-route fixed point
material effect is required for HUMAN_NOW
human handoff preserves what was tested, what was learned, what remains undecidable, why no AI-side next step exists, and what material choice remains
no semantic truth or execution authority
trigger_conditions: K0 preserves impact, causal reach, adversarial views and problem-solving paths
the live 76-item revalidation demonstrated that integrating second-pass counter-evidence can convert apparent human candidates into AI-side verification work
negative_triggers: high impact automatically authorizes HUMAN_NOW while a probe remains
perspective disagreement automatically authorizes HUMAN_NOW while evidence can discriminate
uncertainty or low confidence is treated as verification exhaustion
attempt count or retry count is treated as proof of exhaustion
missing verification evidence is treated as exhausted verification
new knowledge from DA, Counter-DA or probes is not incorporated before deciding whether the AI is exhausted
the same unresolved question is repeated without showing how accumulated evidence changed the remaining UNKNOWN
safe defer exists but HUMAN_NOW is emitted
material unresolved choice remains after proven exhaustion but is silently deferred
HUMAN_NOW lacks an auditable handoff packet explaining tested paths, learned evidence, residual ambiguity and why no discriminating AI-side route remains
blocked or stale upstream evidence receives a normal disposition
dependencies: RTS-FRZ-000021 Adversarial Human Review Necessity Triage v1
possible_destinations: bounded human decision queue with exhaustion handoff packet
